integChoice.reason: Cheapest core-resource exercise: HttpNamespace + Service.createService + registerNonIpInstance + registerIpInstance + an HTTP health check. Zero VPC, zero load balancer, and no Route53 public/private hosted zone (unlike the public/private/cname integs), so it deploys fast and free with no external DNS domain dependency while still covering the module's central Namespace->Service->Instance flow. The private-dns integ was rejected (needs a VPC + ApplicationLoadBalancer = costly, cross-module compute deps); public-dns and cname create billable public hosted zones.

layoutNotes: DIR + EXPORT STRATEGY: new submodule src/aws/edge/cloudmap/ (tests test/aws/edge/cloudmap/, integ apps integ/aws/edge/apps/). aws-servicediscovery is CloudMap; per the namespace registry it targets 'edge', but its type names are generic (Service, Instance, DnsRecordType, RoutingPolicy, HealthCheckType, NamespaceType, HealthCheckConfig) and would collide across the edge barrel and other namespaces if flattened. Therefore use the namespaced submodule precedent (compute/index.ts, notify/index.ts): the cloudmap barrel (src/aws/edge/cloudmap/index.ts) re-exports the files flat internally, and the PARENT edge barrel gains a single line `export * as cloudmap from "./cloudmap";`. Consumers write `edge.cloudmap.HttpNamespace`, etc. COLLISION RESOLUTION: only concrete overlap found in edge today is `RecordType` (edge/dns-record.ts) vs cloudmap's `DnsRecordType` — different names, but the namespaced re-export makes the whole question moot; no rename needed. ALREADY-PORTED CODE TO REUSE (import, do not duplicate): (1) IVpc for private-dns-namespace comes from src/aws/compute (upstream aws-ec2 -> compute) — `import * as ec2 from '../../compute'`, access `.vpcId`; read src/aws/edge/dns-zone.ts for the exact ec2.IVpc private-zone idiom the plan flagged. (2) ILoadBalancerV2 for Service.registerLoadBalancer comes from src/aws/compute (upstream aws-elasticloadbalancingv2 -> compute, lives in compute/lb-shared/base-load-balancer.ts) — `import * as elbv2 from '../../compute'`, access `.loadBalancerDnsName`. (3) AwsConstructBase/IAwsConstruct/AwsStack from src/aws (reached via '../../' from cloudmap files); ValidationError/UnscopedValidationError from src/errors ('../../../errors'); Duration/Names/Lazy from cdktn. PATH DEPTH: cloudmap is one level deeper than existing edge files, so where edge/dns-zone.ts writes '../' / '../compute' / '../../errors', cloudmap files write '../../' / '../../compute' / '../../../errors'. PROVIDER MAPPING (verified in @cdktn/provider-aws/lib): CfnHttpNamespace->service-discovery-http-namespace, CfnPublicDnsNamespace->service-discovery-public-dns-namespace, CfnPrivateDnsNamespace->service-discovery-private-dns-namespace, CfnService->service-discovery-service, CfnInstance->service-discovery-instance; attribute getters .id/.arn (+ .name on service, .hostedZone on the two DNS namespaces); instance ref->.id; upstream `instanceAttributes`->provider `attributes` map. NAMING (HARD INVARIANT 1): NONE of the five CloudMap provider resources expose name_prefix — all use a required/exact `name`. Namespace names (HttpNamespace/PublicDnsNamespace/PrivateDnsNamespace) are user-required semantic DNS/service identifiers -> pass `props.name` through verbatim (document the intentional non-stack-scoping inline; prefixing a DNS namespace name is wrong). Service `name` is optional upstream (CFN-generated) but required by the provider -> use exact-form fallback `props.name ?? this.stack.uniqueResourceName(this)`. Instance `instanceId` mirrors upstream Names.uniqueId/uniqueInstanceId generation. No stateful-replacement escape-hatch flag needed beyond noting that a stack rename changes generated Service names. NO CANNED METRICS: the built bundle (conversion-run/cdklib/.../aws-servicediscovery/lib) contains NO *-canned-metrics.generated.js and the module exposes no metricXxx() methods, so gen-canned-metrics.mjs is NOT run for this module. BARREL WIRING ASSIGNMENT: the src/aws/edge/cloudmap/index.ts converter (order 5) both creates the cloudmap barrel AND adds the `export * as cloudmap from "./cloudmap";` line to src/aws/edge/index.ts. INHERENT CYCLE: service.ts (order 3) <-> instance implementation files (order 4) and instance.ts/private/utils.ts (order 2) form the upstream service<->instance value/type cycle; service.ts is converted first because it defines the shared enums/interfaces, and it references the order-4 instance classes exactly as upstream does (TS resolves the cycle at runtime). servicediscovery.generated.ts is DROPPED (no L1 codegen in this repo; provider resources replace it).
